I'll check with her tomorrow to see what she did with it.

	9/24/2024 05:53 PM  
		 
		 To: Angela Jones  
		 cc: Bonnie Gardner  
		 Subject: Crestview Partners  

Angela,  
Bonnie,  

I have attached an amended credit memo for the referenced portfolio company. This amended memo includes a guarantee from its parent entity of $5 million, thus increasing the collateral threshold to $5 million, and amending other credit covenants.

Per the Portfolio Ops comment in Investor Relations, Bonnie received a call from the portfolio company requesting a 'less complicated' agreement. In the comment, Bonnie suggested using a Local Market Guarantee form; if this agreement is OK from a Portfolio Ops standpoint, I am fine using the Local Market Guarantee from an Investor Relations standpoint.  

Please draft this amended credit memo to an amended Local Market Guarantee.  

Thank you,  

Ryan
